correctness.rationale: PASS: With ordered lifted car coordinates p_i(t+1)=min(p_i(t)+v,p_{i+1}(t)-1), induction gives vt+min_{0<=j<=t}[p_{i+j}(0)-(v+1)j]. The period-m increment n-(v+1)m is nonnegative so each car has reached its unrestricted v-motion by t=m-1. A strict new minimum at j=m-1 characterizes delay at the last step. Reversed m-1 gaps u_j must have nonnegative entries with partial sums <=vj-1, which is a standard v-root full (v+1)-ary ordered forest word. Two last-delayed cars would give negative sums on disjoint complementary arcs, contradicting total increment >=0, so the marker is unique. Lagrange inversion for H=1+zH^(v+1) gives [z^(m-1)]H^v=binom((v+1)m-2,m-1)/m; closing gap >=v+1; n labelled choices divided by unique marker give n/m times binomial. Fixed-surplus probability follows from two elementary binomial ratios, including h=0. Independent full gap-recursion enumeration for v=2,3,4 and m=2,3,4 at n=(v+1)m yielded maxima m-1, extreme marked-gap counts binom((v+1)m-2,m-1), and labelled 12,63,360,24,180,1456,40,390,4080 respectively. Entire parameter proof is analytic, not finite extrapolation.
